findings.why: The first run skipped R133 as 'hierarchy.csv supplies it'; that was wrong. Only this dossier listed the four republics as predecessors (checked across all polities): compile_dossiers.py birth() lets a found take predecessor cells outright (allowed list), and self.succ makes R2 (succession) decide every later conflict for the Union before R3 (hierarchy) is consulted, so the constituent rows 302-306 never acted (2 Nov 22:32 compile: 681,458 R2 cell-years for the Union against the RSFSR, 1923-1956; p1930 RSFSR 851 cells, Byelorussian SSR 94, Armenian SSR 6, Azerbaijan SSR 5). Page re-read: infobox 'Treaty of Creation: 30 December 1922'; 'all four being the founding republics who signed the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR in December 1922'; 'Constitutionally, the USSR was a federation of constituent Union Republics'; 'With the constitution of 1936, the Transcaucasian SFSR was dissolved'; RSFSR, Ukrainian SSR and Byelorussian SSR are in the list of the 15 union republics 'Between July 1956 and September 1991'. The page does not literally say the founders 'kept their status' (the window's wording), but none of the four ended, so they are constituents, not predecessors; the TSFSR dissolves in 1936 into Armenia, Georgia and Azerbaijan, which have their own hierarchy rows (and, as TSFSR/successor pairs listing each other, R2 gives the later-born TSFSR the 1922-1936 conflicts against them). Later USSR events checked against do_event (gain takes held_by(counterpart); loss, contest and occupation use held_by(Union)): gains from third states are unaffected, and window patches p1930 ev3, p1940 ev14/15/16/19 and p1960 ev3/4 already hand annexed land to the Ukrainian and Byelorussian SSR as 'gain from union-of-soviet-socialist-republics', which still finds the Union-held cells. Losses and contests inside the four republics (ledger 20, 22, 26, 27, 28, 29, 40, 50) now move or tint only land the Union holds directly; the republic dossiers carry the German occupation (Byelorussian SSR ledger 15-16; Ukrainian SSR 38-45; RSFSR 48-58) except the Stalingrad contest and the exact Sevastopol timing; handed off. No 1956 event in the Union ledger needed a change (the 1956 conflicts were the RSFSR/Karelo-Finnish pair). The compiler was not run (not mine), so the effect is predicted from the code and the 2 Nov outputs, not measured; the orchestrator should recompile and read conflicts_settled_by_rule.csv (RSFSR vs Union should turn from R2 to R3) and noop_events.csv for the Union's ledger 20, 22, 26-29, 40, 50.
